test_cases.summary:
Verify Selected items array update on select
when no images are selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: Image Selection Logic
Scenario: Selected items array update on select
Given no images are selected
When the user selects an image
Then the image ID should be added to selectedItems array
test_cases.acceptance:
The image ID should be added to selectedItems array
The behavior should be validated when the user selects an image.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Selected items array update on deselect
when an image is selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: Image Selection Logic
Scenario: Selected items array update on deselect
Given an image is selected
When the user deselects the image
Then the image ID should be removed from selectedItems array
test_cases.acceptance:
The image ID should be removed from selectedItems array
The behavior should be validated when the user deselects the image.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Select All option visible
when the image grid header is displayed
test_cases.description:
Feature: Image Selection Logic
Scenario: Select All option visible
Given the image grid header is displayed
When the page loads
Then the Select All checkbox should be visible
test_cases.acceptance:
The Select All checkbox should be visible
The behavior should be validated when the page loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Select All selects all images on page
when multiple images exist on the current page
test_cases.description:
Feature: Image Selection Logic
Scenario: Select All selects all images on page
Given multiple images exist on the current page
When the user clicks Select All
Then all images on the page should be selected
test_cases.acceptance:
All images on the page should be selected
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Select All.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Deselect All clears selection
when multiple images are selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: Image Selection Logic
Scenario: Deselect All clears selection
Given multiple images are selected
When the user toggles Select All off
Then all selected images should be deselected
test_cases.acceptance:
All selected images should be deselected
The behavior should be validated when the user toggles Select All off.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Send Selected for QC enabled
when at least one image is selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: Image Selection Logic
Scenario: Send Selected for QC enabled
Given at least one image is selected
When the UI updates
Then Send Selected for QC button should be enabled
test_cases.acceptance:
Send Selected for QC button should be enabled
The behavior should be validated when the UI updates.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Send Selected for QC disabled when no selection
when no images are selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: Image Selection Logic
Scenario: Send Selected for QC disabled when no selection
Given no images are selected
When the grid is displayed
Then Send Selected for QC button should remain disabled
test_cases.acceptance:
Send Selected for QC button should remain disabled
The behavior should be validated when the grid is displayed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Selection blocked in Freeze mode
when the grid is in Freeze mode
test_cases.description:
Feature: Image Selection Logic
Scenario: Selection blocked in Freeze mode
Given the grid is in Freeze mode
When the user clicks an image
Then selection should be blocked
test_cases.acceptance:
Selection should be blocked
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks an image.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Cursor restriction indicator in Freeze mode
when Freeze mode is active
test_cases.description:
Feature: Image Selection Logic
Scenario: Cursor restriction indicator in Freeze mode
Given Freeze mode is active
When the user hovers over an image
Then a restricted cursor icon should appear
test_cases.acceptance:
A restricted cursor icon should appear
The behavior should be validated when the user hovers over an image.

test_cases.summary:
Verify No partial selection in Freeze mode
when Freeze mode is active
test_cases.description:
Feature: Image Selection Logic
Scenario: No partial selection in Freeze mode
Given Freeze mode is active
When user attempts multiple clicks
Then no image should be added to selectedItems
test_cases.acceptance:
No image should be added to selectedItems
The behavior should be validated when user attempts multiple clicks.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Clear visual distinction between selected and unselected images
when images are selected and unselected

Feature: Image Selection Logic
Scenario: Clear visual distinction between selected and unselected images
Given images are selected and unselected

test_cases.acceptance:
Selected images should be clearly distinguishable
The behavior should be validated when viewed together.

test_cases.summary:

When the user selects an image
Then the UI should update instantly without lag
test_cases.acceptance:
The UI should update instantly without lag
The behavior should be validated when the user selects an image.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Selecting all images on last page

Feature: Image Selection Logic

test_cases.acceptance:
